# Annex 1: Height-diameter models {#sec-annex-hd .unnumbered}

Comparison of the height-diameter models tested for the prediction of missing tree heights, see @sec-hd-model.

In @tbl-hd-models, RMSE and bias (prediction minus measurement) are computed on all measured heights, and the forest type bias is the largest absolute bias of a forest type. Random parameters is the number of parameters with a cluster random effect, and cluster curves the number of clusters with their own curve.

```{r}
#| label: 05-hd-models
#| results: asis
print_tab(fmt_tab(tab$hd_models), "Comparison of height-diameter models", "tbl-hd-models")
```

::: landscape-annex

# Annex 2: Results by forest type and region {#sec-annex-region .unnumbered}

Estimates for each forest type within each administrative region. Many domains have few plots and the estimates are indicative only. ME is not given for domains with a single plot. Definitions are in @sec-results.

## Forest area {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| label: 05-area-region
#| results: asis
print_annex(tab$a_area, "area", "Area of forest types")
```

## Tree species composition and diversity {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| label: 05-ivi-region
#| results: asis
print_annex(top_n_levels(tab$b_ivi_species, 10), "ivi-species", "Top 10 species by Importance Value Index", .drop = c("n_pp", "density", "density_mep", "basal_area", "n_sections"))
print_annex(top_n_levels(tab$b_ivi_genus, 10), "ivi-genus", "Top 10 genera by Importance Value Index", .drop = c("n_pp", "density", "density_mep", "basal_area", "n_sections"))
print_annex(top_n_levels(tab$b_ivi_family, 10), "ivi-family", "Top 10 families by Importance Value Index", .drop = c("n_pp", "density", "density_mep", "basal_area", "n_sections"))
print_annex(tab$b_shannon, "shannon", "Shannon diversity index")
```

# Annex 4: Species lists {#sec-annex-species .unnumbered}

## Tree species {.unnumbered}

All tree species recorded in the field plots, including baobabs and palms, with their IUCN Red List category. NA: not assessed or not identified to species level.

```{r}
#| label: 05-species-list
#| results: asis
print_tab(fmt_tab(tab$c_species_iucn, .drop = "tree_iucn_category"), "Tree species recorded and their IUCN Red List category", "tbl-species-list")
```

## Wildlife {.unnumbered}

All wildlife recorded in the accessible field plots, by wildlife type: scientific name, name recorded in the field when it is a common name, IUCN accepted name when the species is recorded under a synonym, and IUCN Red List category (CR Critically Endangered, EN Endangered, VU Vulnerable, NT Near Threatened, LC Least Concern, DD Data Deficient). Records not identified to species are grouped as "Not identified".

```{r}
#| label: 05-wildlife-list
#| results: asis
print_tab(fmt_tab(tab$d_wildlife_list), "Wildlife recorded, with IUCN Red List category", "tbl-wildlife-list")
```

:::
